title: Statement Recency Points, Self-Pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Payoffs
content:
A self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off soon after its latest summary statement earns statement-recency points.

**Clause.** The statement recency is the plain difference in days between the statement date of the account's most recent summary statement and the payment date: 7 days or fewer adds 2 percentage points to the self-pay payoff discount percent; more than 7 days but no more than 14 adds 1 percentage point; a longer recency or no summary statement adds none.

| Days from the most recent summary statement to the payment | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 0 through 7 | 2 |
| 8 through 14 | 1 |
| 15 or more | none |
| no summary statement on the account | none |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, latest summary statement dated 10 October).* Payment on 17 October (7 days): 2 points. On 18 October (8 days): 1 point. On 24 October (14 days): 1 point. On 25 October (15 days): none.
